value.main_text_excerpt:
Building Bridges between the old and the new
Welcome on board!
Would you like to improve your skills in Norwegian?
Our courses help students to communicate.
Through varied and fun exercises, we help you to express yourself better by working on speaking, listening, reading and writing. 
Our focus is on practical, everyday life in Norway.
Our teaching methods include discovering the great outdoors while at the same time practicing what you have learned out in the real world.
We'll look at grammar and improve your cultural knowledge.
Students are welcome to give suggestions as to what they want to improve on, and we will try to meet each individual's needs.
Our teachers are professionals with years of experience in teaching Norwegian as a foreign language.
Est. 2002 = 20+ years in business!
Classes are offered for small groups (min. 3 and max 6 persons), or individually. are accredited and approved by HK-Dir (an executive agency for the Ministry of Education and Research) as provider of Norwegian language studies where our guidelines follow Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).
Where do you want to learn?
Why do students choose
New 2 Norway?
Immersive experiences
We have refined our teaching methods throughout many years of experience to meet our students’ needs. We don’t believe in the old memorize-or-die methodology to learn languages. Instead, we customize our packages so you'll learn through real life experiences and learn to speak the language just like Norwegians do.
Learn Packages
There is a wide range of reasons why professionals and companies need to improve or learn Norwegian. If you are a foreigner living and working in Norway, you will soon realise that it is vital to learn or improve the language when you are trying to move ahead in your career.
These are some of the goals our past students have achieved:
- understand and become part of our culture in a business both International or national,
- pass job interviews (of course in Norwegian),
- communicate in Norwegian with work colleagues and business partners,
- write better texts at work e.g. emails, proposals, reports, etc.,
- give business presentations,
- feel more confident while speaking.
Key takeaways
Personalised experience
Perfect for any schedule
You are in full control
Live Packages
Our Live Packages take place in Oslo where you dive into Norwegian Culture and Traditions in depth of e.g. Oslo history, hidden gems in the city, or learning more about the buildings you pass on your way, or our culinary Norwegian kitchen and recipes.
Together with max 5 others you get to learn new things to demonstrate, and improve your skill and talent in the Norwegian Language in only a few hours.
Key takeaways
Practical Language
Experience the Culture
History and Tradition
Explore Packages
One of the best ways to learn, is through experience and real-life situations. That's exactly what our Explore Language Package offers!
Our Explore Package is an intensive training program through which you’ll learn Norwegian by doing, by talking to people, by interacting in real life scenarios, by living the Norwegian culture.
The program lasts for a week (5 non-consecutive days) and is divided into 20 lessons (45 min. each). During the program you will get to know other students, locals, places and gain a deeper understanding of Norwegian way of life.
Key takeaways
Learn faster
Enjoy nature
Experience Norwegian culture
Our Classes
We help you master the language quicker
Maybe your work colleagues speak Norwegian and you want to improve your communication with them. Maybe you want to interact with locals while travelling across the country. Or maybe you already have Norwegian friends or relatives, and English is not enough anymore.
In any case, our custom-made language courses have helped hundreds of students to speak fluently and reach their desired goals in less time than they think.
We can help you too!
Ready to enrol?
 We are excited to have you joining us as a new student! Should you have any questions about our packages we will be more than happy to help. As soon as we receive your contact information we will get in touch with you.
See you around soon!

pages.main_text_excerpt:
ABOUT
NEW 2 NORWAY´S FOUNDER and SOCIAL ENTREPRENEUR
I love what I do
I love what I do for a living and it shows. With more than 30 years of experience in education, cultural integration, and global travel, I bring a unique perspective to the field of Norwegian language and cultural education services. My motivation to start New 2 Norway grew out of my own experience as an «expat» in the UK and my global travels where I love to immerse myself in the local culture. These experiences gave me an understanding of cultural differences and a deep appreciation for what humans go through when they arrive in their new country.
I grew up in Årdal, which lies at the end of Sognefjorden, our longest fjord, and near the Jotunheimen National Park region on the western side of Norway. Growing up in Årdal instilled a deep love and appreciation for nature and community. At New 2 Norway, I combine my love for nature, collaboration, and language and share that with those who are interested in deepening their connection to Norwegian language and culture during their stay here. We have developed immersive packages — Learn, Live, or Explore — which could include nature excursions where we practice Norwegian at your level. The central ethos of our packages is Unity in Diversity, where we develop learning experiences that speak to our participants diverse backgrounds and stories. There is no challenge too big or too small, and together our team dedicates our utmost energy to every package we create and customize. While we are guides and preservers of Norwegian language, culture, and traditions, you also bring so much to the table. Our goal is to create an environment through mutual respect and care where we can serve as role models to each other. We are so appreciative of what you contribute to Norwegian society and we hope to support you in feeling a deeper sense of belonging.
As a friend pointed out to me, when you have fun and follow your heart, time flies, and it has! In 2022 we celebrated 20 years in business and I am so proud and honored! Without your collaboration, one of our core values, we would not have achieved this, so thank you all for making it happen!
When I am not busy teaching and running New 2 Norway, I am singing in a choir, dancing, doing yoga and meditation, gardening, and traveling.
UNITY IN DIVERSITY
Our Core Values:
Since 2002, these core values have been the steers of New 2 Norway's ship, and wherever you board, these values will serve as our guides together.
We always aim to be a good Role model, listen carefully to your story, and Care that you settle smoothly into your new environment where you will thrive and bring value to our society. We Respect you as a fellow human being, and we all have to Collaborate for the greater good to enrich Norway so it continues to flourish in diversity because of people like you. Thank you for being a part of our wonderful voyage!
With our values onboard for more than 20 years, we are looked upon as Social Entrepreneurs and Incubators from FERD, since February 2025 -
new era begins!
Social Responsibilities
We started our commitment to community service on October, 24th 2022 (United Nations Day).
Since then, we have had the pleasure of supporting young adults' integration into the Norwegian community through volunteer work opportunties. Whether they wanted to pursue fulltime jobs or return to school, we were there to support them on their journey. We are ever so grateful for this mentoring experience, which we are committed to continuing.
Packages and Approach
Our History
New Paragraph
2002 | Our Beginning
- New 2 Norway - a total package Relocation, Language Packages, Translation, Culture Aspects
2004 - 2005 | Marketing 
- Marketing Campaigns abroad; mainly Germany, Belgium, Switzerland, the Netherlands
- Office in Nydalen, Oslo 
 
2006 - 2009 | Expanding
 
- Building and expanding networks/ co-workers in Norway and abroad 
- 2009, July, 1st: Bought our own office in Uelands gate in Oslo
 
2010 | Shareholders (AS)
- Main focus: Language Packages
- November, 4th: Shareholders company
 
2011 - 2016 | Packages
- New 2 Britain in London and Tunbrigde Wells - Business English
- New 2 Norway Language Packages in Oslo, Bergen, Stavanger, Trondheim, and at Sognefjorden
 
2012 - 2015 | Ups & Downs
- The Show must go on - Financial Crisis in Europe and ups and downs business wise
- Building and expanding networks/ co-workers in Norway and abroad
 
2016 - 2022 | The Only Way is Up & ups! Down
- The only way is up
- Networking inside and outside Norway
- Learn - Live - Explore Packages (11/ 19)
- Pandemic in the World (2020-22+)
2023 - 2024 | The Only Way is Up
- The only way is up
- Restructured and restarted New 2 Norway after the World changes,
- Reopened New 2 Britain,
- New business partners inside and outside Norway - enlarge our network and collaborators.
The Team
Every member of our team cares deeply about unity in diversity, quality, equality, and integrity. Wherever you me

pages.main_text_excerpt:
A taste of Norway through New 2 Norway’s former student
Paraglider and photographer: M. Riedl
Paraglider and Photographer: M. Riedl
Photographer: M. Rustad
Hello, my name is Elodie. I am French, living in Norway. I needed to perfect my Norwegian to a professional level. Moreover, I have very little free time, been the mother of two.
I was looking for an online language teacher and found New 2 Norway through my professional network.
Tove Jane is a very talented and experienced Norwegian teacher, she is a very lively person and obviously loves what she does. She has always been able to tailor the course to my needs and goals, and her explanations made me learn instantly.
Tove Jane has managed to get me to the professional level I wanted to achieve, and I finally feel confident in Norwegian, both verbally and in writing. I am so glad I found New 2 Norway!
I therefore warmly recommend New 2 Norway for anyone who needs fast result and want a deep understanding of the Norwegian culture.
Elodie, France & Norway
Learn Corporate Business, May 2022
Jeg har vært hjemme i noen dager. De siste 2 månedene var jeg i Norge. Jeg likte Norge og nordmennene veldig godt.
Explore Trondheim Package var nyttig og hyggelig. Nå forstår jeg norsk bedre. Jeg kan lese litt Aftenposten uten Google Translate. Jeg må trene på å snakke norsk. Turene var flotte og i godt selskap.
Så kanskje igjen til neste år.
God sommer og mvh Sonja
Sonja, The Netherlands
Explore Trondheim 2023 and 2024
Ja, jeg likte det veldig godt! Det var så fint!
Jeg tok muntlig eksamen sist tirsdag og jeg besto eksamen! Undervisningen var en stor hjelp.
Vennlig hilsen Wanda
Wanda, Germany
Explore Trondheim June 2023
Tove Jane war sehr flexibel und ist sehr spontan auf meine Bedürfnisse eingegangen. Zweimal hatten wir draussen Unterricht, mit direkter Sprachanwendung : Ticket kaufen, Auskunft fragen und Infos bekommen. Das war ganz toll. Ich hatte Besichtigungen mit einem Guide gebucht. Erlend ist ein ganz toller Guide, der sich sehr bemüht, langsam zu sprechen und die Dinge einfach zu erklären, so dass ich ihn sehr gut verstanden habe. Die Besichtigungen waren auf meine Interessen ausgerichtet, haben mir Sprass gemacht und ich habe viel gelernt.
Ich kann den Kurs, die Lehrerin und den Guide sehr empfehlen! Es war toll!
T. Blondel, Switzerland
1-1 in Oslo, October 2019

We have developed immersive packages — Learn, Live, or Explore — which could include nature excursions where we practice Norwegian at your level. The central ethos of our packages is Unity in Diversity, where we develop learning experiences that speak to our participants diverse backgrounds and stories. There is no challenge too big or too small, and together our team dedicates our utmost energy to every package we create and customize. While we are guides and preservers of Norwegian language, culture, and traditions, you also bring so much to the table. Our goal is to create an environment through mutual respect and care where we can serve as role models to each other. We are so appreciative of what you contribute to Norwegian society and we hope to support you in feeling a deeper sense of belonging.
As a friend pointed out to me, when you have fun and follow your heart, time flies, and it has! In 2022 we celebrated 20 years in business and I am so proud and honored! Without your collaboration, one of our core values, we would not have achieved this, so thank you all for making it happen!
When I am not busy teaching and running New 2 Norway, I am singing in a choir, dancing, doing yoga and meditation, gardening, and traveling.
UNITY IN DIVERSITY
Our Core Values:
Since 2002, these core values have been the steers of New 2 Norway's ship, and wherever you board, these values will serve as our guides together.
We always aim to be a good Role model, listen carefully to your story, and Care that you settle smoothly into your new environment where you will thrive and bring value to our society. We Respect you as a fellow human being, and we all have to Collaborate for the greater good to enrich Norway so it continues to flourish in diversity because of people like you. Thank you for being a part of our wonderful voyage!
With our values onboard for more than 20 years, we are looked upon as Social Entrepreneurs and Incubators from FERD, since February 2025 -
new era begins!
Social Responsibilities
We started our commitment to community service on October, 24th 2022 (United Nations Day).
Since then, we have had the pleasure of supporting young adults' integration into the Norwegian community through volunteer work opportunties. Whether they wanted to pursue fulltime jobs or return to school, we were there to support them on their journey. We are ever so grateful for this mentoring experience, which we are committed to continuing.
Packages and Approach

A taste of Norway through New 2 Norway’s former student
Paraglider and photographer: M. Riedl
Paraglider and Photographer: M. Riedl
Photographer: M. Rustad
Hello, my name is Elodie. I am French, living in Norway. I needed to perfect my Norwegian to a professional level. Moreover, I have very little free time, been the mother of two.
I was looking for an online language teacher and found New 2 Norway through my professional network.
Tove Jane is a very talented and experienced Norwegian teacher, she is a very lively person and obviously loves what she does. She has always been able to tailor the course to my needs and goals, and her explanations made me learn instantly.
Tove Jane has managed to get me to the professional level I wanted to achieve, and I finally feel confident in Norwegian, both verbally and in writing. I am so glad I found New 2 Norway!
I therefore warmly recommend New 2 Norway for anyone who needs fast result and want a deep understanding of the Norwegian culture.
Elodie, France & Norway
Learn Corporate Business, May 2022
Jeg har vært hjemme i noen dager. De siste 2 månedene var jeg i Norge. Jeg likte Norge og nordmennene veldig godt.
Explore Trondheim Package var nyttig og hyggelig. Nå forstår jeg norsk bedre. Jeg kan lese litt Aftenposten uten Google Translate. Jeg må trene på å snakke norsk. Turene var flotte og i godt selskap.
Så kanskje igjen til neste år.
God sommer og mvh Sonja
Sonja, The Netherlands
Explore Trondheim 2023 and 2024
Ja, jeg likte det veldig godt! Det var så fint!
Jeg tok muntlig eksamen sist tirsdag og jeg besto eksamen! Undervisningen var en stor hjelp.
Vennlig hilsen Wanda
Wanda, Germany
Explore Trondheim June 2023
Tove Jane war sehr flexibel und ist sehr spontan auf meine Bedürfnisse eingegangen. Zweimal hatten wir draussen Unterricht, mit direkter Sprachanwendung : Ticket kaufen, Auskunft fragen und Infos bekommen. Das war ganz toll. Ich hatte Besichtigungen mit einem Guide gebucht. Erlend ist ein ganz toller Guide, der sich sehr bemüht, langsam zu sprechen und die Dinge einfach zu erklären, so dass ich ihn sehr gut verstanden habe. Die Besichtigungen waren auf meine Interessen ausgerichtet, haben mir Sprass gemacht und ich habe viel gelernt.
Ich kann den Kurs, die Lehrerin und den Guide sehr empfehlen! Es war toll!
T. Blondel, Switzerland
